Answer: Radium mimicking calcium in the bones
Detail: Radium is a "bone-seeker." Because it sits in the same column of the periodic table as calcium, the body mistakenly uses it to build bone tissue. Once integrated, the radium emits alpha particles that cause localized necrosis and spontaneous fractures.
